subject.title: [Feature]: Control console session list should show full date

question: Should the Sessions Updated column use the reporter's fixed YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm format, a locale-aware full date/time using existing UI time-format preferences, or remain relative-only?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the durable product choice affects localization, user time-format preferences, and whether the existing cross-repo PR should be adopted or replaced.

options.title: Use locale-aware full date/time
options.body: Show a full local date/time through existing UI date/time helpers while preserving relative time as optional tooltip context and localized fallback text.

options.title: Use fixed requested format
options.body: Honor the exact YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm request, accepting a less locale-aware display for a predictable compact table value.

options.title: Keep relative-only
options.body: Reject the feature direction and close the request if maintainers prefer the current compact relative Sessions list behavior.

recommendation.title: Use locale-aware full date/time
recommendation.body: Show a full local date/time through existing UI date/time helpers while preserving relative time as optional tooltip context and localized fallback text.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev has recent merged work in the Sessions UI and related localization-sensitive Control UI paths, making them the best available routing candidate from the history gathered.
